title: pleopeltis nummularia
intro: Pleopeltis nummularia, commonly known as the Money Plant, is a type of epiphytic fern native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The Money Plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. Its therapeutic actions include being a natural expectorant and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful for treating coughs, colds, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of Pleopeltis nummularia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
